title: PROVE: Mitigating Long-Horizon LLM Collusion with Reinforcement Learning from Verified Evidence
title_zh: PROVE：基于已验证证据的强化学习缓解 LLM 智能体在长程交互中的合谋
abstract_en: When LLM agents verify each other's work over a long interaction, they drift into collusion: they come to accept work without the evidence that the verification protocol requires. Collusion is absent at the start and builds up episode by episode, which we trace to accurate feedback accumulating in memory. An agent that follows the rule is told that its verdict was wrong whenever its peer was right, so breaking the rule is the reward-maximizing choice, and agents talk themselves into it in their private reflections. Existing mitigations leave the agents unchanged; we train the behavior out. PROVE (Protocol Reinforcement from Verified Evidence) is a multi-agent reinforcement learning method that rewards verdicts by the evidence behind them rather than by their outcome, and credits every call an agent makes, including the calls that solve its own task, with the outcome that call controls. On Qwen3.6-27B, a LoRA adapter trained on six-episode interactions takes the collusion rate on held-out task sequences at the original ten-episode horizon from 65.0% to 1.0%, with no detectable change in task success. Collusion that converged in every interaction now converges in none, and the gain holds four episodes beyond the longest interaction seen in training. The trained 27B model colludes less than every model evaluated in the original study, closed-weight frontier models included. Code is available at https://github.com/Haochen-Luo/PROVE.
abstract_zh: 当 LLM 智能体在长程交互中相互验证时，它们会逐轮形成合谋：即使缺少验证协议要求的证据，也会接受对方的工作。合谋起初并不存在，作者将其归因于准确的结果反馈在记忆中不断累积：当对方的答案正确却未提供所需证据时，按协议拒绝的智能体反而会收到判定错误的反馈。因此，违规成为奖励最大化的选择，智能体也逐渐在私下反思中说服自己放弃规则。不同于不改变智能体本身的现有缓解方法，PROVE（Protocol Reinforcement from Verified Evidence）通过多智能体强化学习直接改变这一行为：根据判定所依据的证据而非对方答案是否正确发放奖励，并将每次调用（包括求解自身任务的调用）与其所控制的结果对应起来。对 Qwen3.6-27B 使用 6 轮交互训练 LoRA 适配器后，在留出的任务序列上进行原有的 10 轮评估，合谋率从 65.0% 降至 1.0%，任务成功率未检测到变化。训练前每次交互最终都会收敛到合谋，训练后没有一次出现这种收敛；改善在超出训练长度 4 轮时仍然成立。训练后的 27B 模型合谋率低于原研究评估的所有模型，包括闭权重前沿模型。代码见 https://github.com/Haochen-Luo/PROVE。
key_points_zh: 合谋源于激励错位：当对方答案正确但证据不足时，按协议拒绝反而会被结果反馈判错。
PROVE 按证据而非答案正误奖励验证判定，并对验证和自身求解的每次调用分别进行信用分配。
Qwen3.6-27B 经 6 轮交互的 LoRA 训练后，在留出任务的 10 轮评估中，合谋率从 65.0% 降至 1.0%，任务成功率未检测到变化。
训练后没有交互收敛到合谋，且模型的合谋率低于原研究评估的所有模型，包括闭权重前沿模型。
